crossRefs.note: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify Yahweh, the God of your fathers’…
They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s…
But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites…
Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and…
For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves: therefore the Levites were in charge of killing…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early…
Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and…
These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

translations.web: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;
translations.bsb: Now all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves regardless of their divisions. And when the priests came out of the Holy Place,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
